description: Find and save candidate Instagram/TikTok profiles through this user's separately connected browser sessions. Supply query, location, languages, purpose, platforms and limit (1–20). Optional profileUrls inspect known profiles instead of native search. Sessions must be connected through the Social contacts screen; you cannot enter credentials. Saves only observed public bios, links and contact details with source/time. Candidates are not guaranteed matches: read their evidence and report partial/login/challenge states, never fabricate missing contacts or claim the requested count was reached. Does not follow, like, send DMs or email.
